title: TMB and Jbob presents a wonderful single "Wat u Kno"
htmlContent:
TMB and Jbob's "Wat u Kno" is one of those records that makes life more festive. Everything about this record is enjoyable, to make people fall in love with music endlessly. If you’re looking for your next ultimate jam to dive into, look no further than this record here that is ready for the world.

TMB comes together with Jbob to make a record that shines like the season on the new song “Was u know”. The sound is packed with unlimited appeal, with must hear production that is packed with bright melodies to make you feel the glow of the music. Jbob delivers the writing perfectly, with a big time tone that you can feel in your spirit, as you get taken in by the music.
